##### Project general facts

Marbella Resort Hotel, part of the prestigious Vignette Collection, captures the vibrant energy and timeless charm of Spain's most glamorous coastal city. This intimate boutique hotel on the water's edge celebrates life with the passion and charisma of Spanish culture, where time is unhurried and every moment invites you to breathe in fresh sea air, enjoy the beach, and cherish the company of others. Here, you are so close to Dubai yet so far away, too.

The gastronomy and wines are faithful to Spain's rich flavours, passionately created and generously served. Masterful music fills the air, and sunset is a nightly wonder. Guests enjoy a lifestyle defined by celebration and relaxation, where every detail is designed to create an unforgettable experience by the sea.

Every residence at Marbella Resort Hotel features premium finishing with high-quality materials, fully equipped kitchens, and fully furnished interiors. The design reflects the glamour and prestige of the Marbella lifestyle, offering a refined and sophisticated living experience that celebrates life in the most beautiful way.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled within The World Islands, a remarkable man-made archipelago located off the coast of Dubai, this exceptional location offers a symbol of opulence and grandeur. The ambitious development comprises a collection of small islands shaped like a world map, each representing a different country or region, designed to offer luxurious and exclusive living experiences.

The location is distinguished by its unparalleled privacy and exclusivity. The islands provide an elite retreat for residents and visitors, offering lavish villas, mansions, and private estates with panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and access to pristine beaches. High-end resorts, boutique hotels, and entertainment facilities ensure world-class dining, spa treatments, and water sports are always within reach.

For those seeking a residence that embodies Spanish charisma, island seclusion, and the ultimate in luxury living, The World Islands deliver an unmatched lifestyle. Their unique combination of man-made grandeur, natural beauty, and a prestigious Dubai address makes them one of the most desirable destinations in the world. This is a place where one can celebrate life — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected to the city that has it all.
